description.zh: 跨地域备份文件ID。可以通过接口DescribeCrossRegionBackups查看备份集ID。
description.en: The ID of the cross-region data backup file. You can call the DescribeCrossRegionBackups operation to query the backup file ID.
The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID.

title.zh: 查询备份文件可恢复的时间段

descriptions.zh:
> 查看普通备份文件可恢复哪个时间段的数据请参见DescribeBackups。
### 适用引擎
RDS MySQL（高性能本地盘）

descriptions.en:
>  To view the time range within which you can restore data from a standard backup set, see DescribeBackups.

ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances with local disks
